title: The Big Question
bullets: Is your data safe for the next 10 years?
Quantum computers threaten the shelf-life of encrypted data
story: Like locking your house with a lock that expires tomorrow.
activity: Think of one sensitive data you store.
enterpriseInsight: Data with >10 year value is already at risk from SNDL attacks.

interpretations.meaning: Time when an adversary captures your encrypted data

title: Why This Talk Matters
bullets: RSA-2048 is the industry standard for identity and key exchange
Quantum computers perform integer factorization in polynomial time
The entire PKI (Public Key Infrastructure) depends on these math traps
activity: List systems using RSA/ECC.
enterpriseInsight: Banking and Telecom rely on trust-at-distance; quantum breaks that distance.

title: Everyday Security
bullets: TLS 1.2/1.3: The handshake protocol of the internet
Digital Signatures: Verifying code and identities
story: Your messages are like sealed envelopes.
activity: Check the padlock icon in your browser.
enterpriseInsight: Consumer tech vulnerabilities often bleed into corporate VPNs.

title: Problem Statement
bullets: Quantum computers: Shor's algorithm reduces 2^n to polynomial complexity
Bit-security levels are being halved (AES-128 becomes AES-64 effective)
story: Solving a maze instantly vs walking through.
activity: Use a complex password mentally.
enterpriseInsight: Legacy systems cannot simply be patched; they must be re-architected.

title: Session Roadmap
bullets: Technical Foundations: From Bits to Qubits
The Threat Model: Shor's and Grover's Algorithms
Strategic Response: NIST PQC Standards (ML-KEM, ML-DSA)
activity: Identify your key learning goal.
enterpriseInsight: Quantum readiness is a 5-year project; start now.

title: What is Encryption?
activity: Create a simple Caesar cipher.
enterpriseInsight: Encryption is the primary control for Data Privacy (GDPR/HIPAA).

title: Types of Encryption
bullets: Hybrid: RSA for keys, AES for data
activity: Identify where you use public keys.
enterpriseInsight: Most enterprises use hybrid models; only the handshake is quantum-vulnerable.

title: Public Key Concept
bullets: One-Way Functions: f(x) is easy, f^-1(y) is hard
Trapdoor Functions: Easy with a 'secret' hint
story: Open mailbox, only owner opens letters.
activity: Think of a physical one-way function.
enterpriseInsight: Public keys are published; your adversary already has them.

title: RSA Basics
bullets: Prime selection: p and q must be large (>1024 bits)
Modular Exponentiation: C = M^e mod n
Complexity: Based on Integer Factorization Problem (IFP)

interactivity.feedback: 11 x 13. Classical computers take centuries for 2048-bit numbers.

activity: Multiply two 2-digit primes.
enterpriseInsight: RSA is the bedrock of corporate SSH and code signing.

interpretations.meaning: The modulus shared with the world

title: Why It Works Today
bullets: Number Field Sieve (NFS): The fastest classical algorithm
Resource gap: Classical hardware cannot scale to factor 2048-bit keys
activity: Calculate complexity for n=1024.
enterpriseInsight: We are safe from classical hackers, but quantum hackers play by different rules.

title: What is Quantum Computing?
bullets: Qubits: Superconducting loops or Trapped ions
Coherence: Maintaining the quantum state (T1/T2 times)
Gate Fidelity: Accuracy of quantum operations (>99.9% target)
activity: Visualize a 3D Bloch Sphere.
enterpriseInsight: Quantum is not a faster CPU; it's a completely different logic engine.

title: Qubits Explained
bullets: Probability Amplitudes: a and b are complex numbers
Information Capacity: 2^n states with n qubits
story: Student attending two classes at once.
activity: Compare 2 bits vs 2 qubits.
enterpriseInsight: Information density is the quantum advantage.

title: Superposition
bullets: Interference: Constructive (increase prob) vs Destructive (decrease prob)
Quantum Algorithms: Manipulation of interference to find 'correct' answer
Wave-particle duality at the compute level
activity: Imagine a wave canceling another wave.
enterpriseInsight: Quantum computers 'see' all possibilities simultaneously through interference.

title: Entanglement
bullets: Non-locality: Correlation beyond the speed of light
Quantum Key Distribution (QKD): Using entanglement for absolute security
activity: Try to separate the 'twins'.
enterpriseInsight: Entanglement allows for tamper-evident data transmission.

title: Quantum Speed
bullets: Optimization: Quantum Annealing vs Universal Gate
activity: Find a name in a 1M entry phonebook.
enterpriseInsight: Symmetric keys (AES) must be doubled in length to stay safe.

title: Current Status
bullets: Road to Fault Tolerance: Error Correction (QEC)
activity: Search for 'Quantum Volume' metric.
enterpriseInsight: We are currently in the 'pre-browser' phase of quantum computing.

title: What Changes?
bullets: Mathematical hardness is no longer a barrier
Discrete Logarithm Problem (DLP) and IFP collapse
The 'One-Way' nature of current crypto vanishes
activity: Imagine a world with no digital secrets.
enterpriseInsight: Encryption becomes a checkbox that no longer provides security.

title: Shor’s Algorithm
activity: Compare O(log n)^3 vs O(exp(n^(1/3))).
enterpriseInsight: Shor's is the 'Doomsday' algorithm for classical asymmetric crypto.

title: Encryption Break Timeline
bullets: RSA-2048 Break: Estimate ~20M noisy qubits or ~10k logical qubits
The 'Quantum Leap': From labs to server rooms
activity: Calculate qubits needed for RSA-4096.
enterpriseInsight: We are one breakthrough in error-correction away from total exposure.

title: Harvest Now, Decrypt Later
bullets: SNDL: Store Now, Decrypt Later (Passive Harvesting)
Retroactive decryption of today's captured traffic
activity: Identify data that must remain secret for 30 years.
enterpriseInsight: Today's 'Safe' traffic is tomorrow's 'Cleartext' database.

title: Industries at Risk
activity: Rank industries by data 'shelf-life'.
enterpriseInsight: Critical infrastructure is the primary target for quantum-armed nation-states.

title: Enterprise Exposure
activity: Audit the oldest server in your data center.
enterpriseInsight: The weakest link in your supply chain is likely a legacy RSA key.

title: Cloud Security Risk

caseStudy.background: AWS, Azure, and GCP rely on RSA/ECC for hypervisor management and tenant isolation.
caseStudy.technicalRisk: Breaking the hypervisor's Root-of-Trust allows cross-tenant memory access.
caseStudy.mitigation: Quantum-Safe Hardware Security Modules (HSMs) and ML-KEM encapsulation.
caseStudy.experimentSetup: Intercepting the key exchange between a Cloud Edge and a Client.
caseStudy.insight: Cloud data-at-rest is safe (AES), but data-in-transit is the primary quantum target.

activity: Audit your cloud shared-responsibility model.
enterpriseInsight: Cloud providers are early adopters; verify their PQC roadmap.

title: IoT Vulnerability
story: Your coffee machine is a spy.

caseStudy.background: Billions of smart meters and industrial sensors use fixed ECC certificates.
caseStudy.technicalRisk: A single forged Root Cert can update a billion devices with malicious firmware.
caseStudy.mitivity: Stateless PQC signatures like SLH-DSA (Sphincs+) for offline verification.
caseStudy.experimentSetup: Injecting a signed malicious payload into a smart grid meter.
caseStudy.insight: IoT devices lack the memory for large PQC keys; optimization is critical.

activity: Check the update protocol of your office smart-bulbs.
enterpriseInsight: Managed IoT is an enterprise perimeter; unmanaged IoT is a hole.

title: Telecom Infrastructure
story: Tapping into every wire at once.

caseStudy.background: Global mobile roaming relies on SS7 and Diameter protocols using legacy PKI.
caseStudy.technicalRisk: Intercepting a 5G session key exchange allows real-time voice decryption.
caseStudy.mitigation: Implementing Hybrid Diffie-Hellman with Kyber-768 for cell-link encryption.
caseStudy.experimentSetup: Simulation of a quantum 'Stingray' device at a network exchange.
caseStudy.insight: Telecom data is high-volume and long-term; it's a prime target for harvesting.

activity: Check your phone's VPN settings.
enterpriseInsight: Network backbones are the first place to implement PQC.

title: Banking Systems

caseStudy.background: High-value fund transfers require non-repudiation via RSA signatures.
caseStudy.technicalRisk: Forgery of a $1B transfer message that appears perfectly authentic.
caseStudy.mitigation: Hash-based signatures (LMS/XMSS) which are proven quantum-resistant.
caseStudy.experimentSetup: Creating a fake digital signature that bypasses a bank's verification.
caseStudy.insight: Banking is about trust; quantum forgery destroys the mathematical proof of intent.

activity: Look at the 'Signed by' info on your bank's PDF statements.
enterpriseInsight: Transaction finality must be anchored in PQC immediately.

title: Government Data

caseStudy.background: State secrets are protected by classified asymmetric algorithms (Suite B).
caseStudy.technicalRisk: Decryption of decades of diplomatic cables, revealing global informants.
caseStudy.mitigation: Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) using physical photons.
caseStudy.experimentSetup: Intercepting a secure burst transmission from a satellite ground-station.
caseStudy.insight: For governments, 'Safe Now' is not enough; 'Safe Forever' is the goal.

activity: Research the 'CNSA' PQC recommendations.
enterpriseInsight: Gov-contractors must comply with new PQC mandates (CSNA 2.0).

title: Supply Chain Systems

caseStudy.background: OEMs sign driver and BIOS updates using global Root-CAs.
caseStudy.technicalRisk: A quantum-armed actor signs a malicious BIOS that hides in the hardware.
caseStudy.experimentSetup: Injecting a signed backdoor into a MICRO-CODE update.
caseStudy.insight: Supply chain security is transitive; if your vendor is vulnerable, you are too.

activity: Check the publisher of your latest Windows update.
enterpriseInsight: PQC must be a requirement in your next Vendor Risk Assessment.

title: Post-Quantum Cryptography
activity: Compare PQC vs QKD (Math vs Physics).
enterpriseInsight: PQC is the most cost-effective way to secure an enterprise today.

title: Lattice-Based Crypto (ML-KEM)
story: Finding a needle in a 500D haystack.
activity: Visualize a 2D Lattice vs 500D.
enterpriseInsight: ML-KEM is the industry choice for general-purpose encryption.

title: Hash-Based Crypto
activity: Visualize a Merkle Tree structure.
enterpriseInsight: Hash-based crypto is the most conservative and safe PQC choice.

title: Code-Based Crypto
bullets: Classic McEliece: 40 years of no breaks
Large keys but very fast decryption
activity: Compare key size: RSA (256B) vs McEliece (256KB).
enterpriseInsight: Best for high-security archival data where key size is not an issue.

title: Crypto Agility
activity: Audit your app for hard-coded 'RSA' strings.
enterpriseInsight: Agility is a feature, not a patch. Build it into your next dev cycle.

title: Hybrid Cryptography
bullets: Safe against both classical and quantum
activity: Understand the 'OR' vs 'AND' security logic.
enterpriseInsight: Hybrids are the 'Safe Zone' for early migration; they guarantee today's security.

title: Risk Assessment
activity: Assign a 'Quantum Risk Score' to your top 3 apps.
enterpriseInsight: Not all data needs PQC today; focus on your 'Crown Jewels' first.

title: Crypto Inventory
activity: Find one self-signed certificate in your network.
enterpriseInsight: You cannot secure what you cannot see. Inventory is 50% of the work.

title: Migration Strategy
activity: Set a target date for 'Quantum-Ready' status.
enterpriseInsight: Migration is a marathon; consistency beats speed.

title: Infrastructure Needs
activity: Estimate the packet overhead of a 1KB signature.
enterpriseInsight: PQC has performance costs; benchmark before you deploy.

title: Final Quiz
activity: Discuss one thing you'll tell your CISO.
enterpriseInsight: Knowledge is the first line of defense.

title: Call to Action
story: Upgrade lock before thief upgrades tools.
activity: Follow Dr. Syed Muzamil Basha for updates.
enterpriseInsight: The future is quantum; make sure your enterprise is ready to welcome it.
